Connect Fleet

What sits behind Connect Fleet

Van trackerEvery vehicle, where it is and who has it. Supplier and contract end on the same screen.

On hire evidenceA van cannot go active until its checklist and timestamped photographs are complete.
ClearQuote trackerThe day's per van inspection sheet, driven by the live ClearQuote feed.
Van service trackerReplaces the servicing spreadsheet nobody kept up to date.
Stopping reportsTracker idling detection, a report every two hours.

03

Connect Compliance

Nobody reaches the rota unchecked.

From risk to ready

Live status and dated evidence keep you covered, without the spreadsheet chase.

  • Document captureDrivers upload their licence and right to work documents from their phone, straight onto their own record.
  • Live compliance statusColour coded: who is clear, who is expiring and who is missing evidence, at a glance.
  • Expiring documentsRight to work and licence dates tracked, amber before they lapse and red once they have.
  • Manager verifiedEvery check confirmed by a manager, dated and attributable to them.
  • Audit readyEvery record is already dated and signed, so producing it takes minutes rather than a scramble.
  • Secure document storageEvery document in one place, filed against the person it belongs to.

What else sits behind Connect Compliance

DVLA check cycleLicences re checked on a monthly cycle, one open cycle per driver.
The rota gateNobody reaches the rota until every check on them is green.
InsightsGap filler and compliance engines you run yourself.
04

Connect Payments

Every pound, proven.

How every pound is proven

From the invoice to the payment, every line accounted for.

  • Real time ledgerEvery addition and deduction lands on the driver's week as a typed line, and the deductions ledger runs week by week.
  • Deductions that workSpeeding and parking fines, van damage, missed shifts. Each one typed, with damage recovered on a payment plan.
  • Full VAT transparencyVAT only when the driver is VAT registered with a number on file, shown on the invoice and frozen when it is issued.
  • Audit ready at any timeEvery invoice and adjustment is already dated and signed, so the trail exists before anyone asks for it.
  • Fully integratedInvoicing, pay and compliance share one record, so the invoice comes from the same driver the rota and the checks already know.
  • Driver statementsDrivers see their own settled weeks, line by line, in their own app.

What else sits behind Connect Payments

Pay runOne screen and one button, built from the week the operation already ran. Anything unusual is held for a decision, never quietly paid.
Self billingEach driver signs the agreement before any invoice is raised in their name.
Invoice checkerEvery invoice read against the week you actually ran, before you pay it.
Sweeps and bonusesEvery pay adjustment line, read and verified before it pays.
P&LThe week's cost against the week you ran, behind one login.

Application to paid, and round again

The journey of Connect Ops.

Every driver takes the same path, on the same record, every week.
  1. ApplicationFrom an Indeed advert or a referral, one record starts here and stays with them.Indeed
  2. Document uploadThrough the candidate's own link, filing straight against their record.
  3. Right to workConfirmed by a manager, dated and attributable, with the proof on their record.Home Office
  4. DVLALicence checked against the DVLA, then checked again on a cycle by rule.DVLA
  5. The rotaThe gate holds until every check on that driver is green.
  6. A vanOn hire evidenced: checklist answers and photographs carrying their own timestamp.
  7. Deductions and bonusesDamage the inspection suggests, a manager confirms. Bonuses itemised before they pay.
  8. The invoiceSelf billing signed first, then raised in their name, line by line.HMRC self billing
  9. PaidBuilt from the week the operation actually ran, not from a separate sheet.
  10. And againNext week starts on the same record. Nothing to set up twice.
